notes.title: The Museum Level is Live
notes.content:
As of about an hour ago, We released a new level called The Museum.

Our Turdler sees his first day trip to the Museum.

Someone unfortunately bought him plastic guns and a bunch of bullets.  Isn’t the gift shop supposed to be at the end of the tour?

Oh dear this is not going to end well .

We hope you enjoy The Museum.

Cheers

BucketShop Software

notes.title: Almost time to take The Turdler on an outing
notes.content:
We’ve been fixing several bugs  and working on a new level.  We think it’s time to take our faecal flinging friend on an outing to the museum.

Who would buy The Turdler a set of plastic dart pistols in a Museum?  The gift shop is on the way out isn’t it?

The Museum level coming soon.

Cheers

BucketShop Software
